dimensions: bo1 10, bo2 10.3 (result of restoration?), be 108, le 2907.5,**** throat 34
remarks: Tubular slides stays, lower one telescopic. Ferrules have ring pattern at proximal and distal ends, dragon-scale pattern in central field. Slide-bow has plain wire ring, saddle with zigzag pattern. Inner slide tubes new. Bell sec. has much new work, with added tubing, rather like a tuning slide, thereby explaining the instrument’s unusually low pitch. One flat bell stay, with floral-leaf pattern, hinge, pin, eyelet. Garland has toothed pattern at top; leaf pattern encircles signature on garland; rim wire with flat seam underneath. Extensively restored by Meinl & Lauber. Examined by the author, June 1999.
